notes: Dedicated empirical / sourced dataset for recombinator physics (§85). Not Sentinel-era. No invented Predictable success formula. No independent 50%-per-mod model.

sentinelCurrencyEra.reason: Sentinel league currency Recombinators and Blast-from-the-Past copies were deleted in 3.26.0. Do not use PoEDB Sentinel count tables or corrupted/mirrored-era rules as current truth.

independentFiftyPercentPerMod.reason: Unpredictable does not keep each mod independently at 50%. Prefix/suffix pools are counted, then fill-order + weighted selection apply (wiki/GGG).

poe2RecombinatingDustFormula.reason: PoE1 spends Gold + Thaumaturgic Dust. PoE2 Recombinating Dust / weight formulas must not be transplanted.

sources.title: Path of Exile 3.26.0 patch notes — Predictable + Unpredictable Recombination
sources.notes: Predictable: choose modifiers; success chance displayed; failure destroys both. Unpredictable: random merge, always succeeds. Fewer average mods when inputs use many cannot-normally-roll mods (Veiled, Essence). Corrupted items cannot be recombinated. Sentinel currencies deleted.

sources.title: PoE Wiki: Recombinator
sources.notes: Two modes (toggle Unpredictable). Unpredictable overview + estimated affix-count table. 50/50 base. 50/50 fill-order. Exclusive ≤1. NNN ineligible on chosen base. Fractured cannot increase / does not transfer off base. Drop-only can transfer. Gold + Thaumaturgic Dust; amount unpublished. Wiki flags Predictable details as incomplete.

sources.title: 3.25: rarer modifiers much higher chance to be selected
Maxroll Recombination Guide (3.25 Settlers; still used for Unpredictable technique)
sources.notes: Empty 1-mod magics inflate dust. Exclusive / NNN technique write-up. Count odds refer to Unpredictable pool table, not a Predictable formula.

sources.title: 3.27.0g Hotfix 2 — Idol recombination cost cut
sources.notes: Idol-only cost cut. Does not publish general gear gold/dust formula.

sources.title: Forum: one Unpredictable vs Predictable gold/dust readout
sources.notes: Single readout on magic weapons — not a formula or armour table.

successChance.notes: GGG/wiki: chance depends on amount and tier of chosen mods. No published closed-form table for PoE1. Model must not invent one — pass displayed/empirical chance or mark unranked (§60).

countDistribution.notes: Estimated Unpredictable table (community wiki). Prefix/suffix independent. Pool 0 → always 0. Not Sentinel PoEDB numbers.

predictable.notes: Success chance is shown in the Recombinator UI. Do not invent a PoE1 formula from PoE2 wiki weights. Without a displayed or empirically recorded chance, Predictable plans are unranked.

samples.notes: One player readout at 6.58%. Not generalized.

cost.notes: GGG has not published a closed-form Gold/Dust function. Physical amounts use the user empirical Unpredictable band midpoints (not 12+2n+0.04*ilvl, never 0). Display ~25k Gold · ~85k Dust. Ranking may use opportunityCostChaos when daily prices lack gold/dust units.

averageUnpredictable.notes: Midpoints of anecdotal Unpredictable smash bands. Not precision; display as ranges or ~midpoints.

opportunityCostChaos.notes: Fallback unit chaos opportunity costs when daily.json has no gold/dust prices. ~25k×0.0002 + ~85k×0.00005 ≈ 9.25c per smash for ranking only. Not a published GGG rate.

samples.notes: Primary EV/display amounts for Unpredictable until a published table exists. Replace this dataset entry when better measurements arrive — do not hardcode in planner code.

compatibility.influence: inherited from chosen base (including dual/eldritch/synth-like status on that base)
compatibility.fractured: cannot increase; does not transfer off its base
compatibility.exclusive: at most one exclusive mod on output

allflame.reason: §51 intentionally unsupported — Allflame / boat crafting is out of scope for the recombinator model.
